scope: Two particular unary algebras on the fixed carrier {0,1,2,3,4}.
assumptions: A grouping is an equivalence relation represented by canonical block labels.
A unary rule is a total map from this carrier to itself.
Minimum counts range over arbitrary finite lists of unary rules realizing the exact relation family.
limits: This input is not proof evidence. Computational and Lean receipts are separate.

method: All 3,125 label assignments produce 52 canonical partitions; all 3,125 total unary maps are evaluated by literal pair preservation. No project mathematics or historical search code is imported.

explanation.A: To exclude 00001, a rule must have destruction profile 1000. Such a rule excludes none of 00123, 01230, 01231. Every other admissible rule excludes at most two of those three. Two rules therefore leave an extra grouping; the displayed three rules recover exactly the eight target groupings.
explanation.B: Every admissible rule preserves at least one of 00001 and 00110, both outside the target family. A single rule therefore leaves an extra grouping; the displayed pair recovers exactly the eight target groupings.
